verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a deprecation policy or a versioned, stable API surface for mise's own CLI, configuration, or MCP server, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The many references to pinning tool versions (node@24, lockfiles, MISE_VERSION in CI) cover the versions of the tools mise manages, or of the mise binary itself, not API versioning with deprecation guarantees. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.
